title: Simple Cheese Mod
body:
Minecraft has plenty of food—but almost no cheese! This mod fixes that by adding **Cheese** and the **Cheese Block** to the game.

Craft Cheese using a **Milk Bucket** and **Cobweb**, then combine **9 Cheese** to create a **Cheese Block**. Whether you're decorating a kitchen, building a giant wheel of cheese, or just want a new snack, this simple mod brings a cheesy twist to your Minecraft world!
